$comment: Hand-written ecology ASSUMPTIONS for the herd simulation. Not model output, not fitted to data. Array entries are indexed by cover class in the order listed in model_card.json (classes[0] .. classes[6]). The comments in docs/ecology-rules.md explain each value. Edit freely; the app validates this file at load time.

vegetation.$classOrderAssumed: Covertype class order: Spruce/Fir, Lodgepole Pine, Ponderosa Pine, Cottonwood/Willow, Aspen, Douglas-fir, Krummholz. If model_card.json lists classes in a different order, reorder these arrays.
